Container.Name: Optimisarr
Container.Overview: Optimisarr optimises video, audio and image libraries with FFmpeg and verifies candidates before replacing originals. Configured checks cover decoding, timing, retained streams, metadata, size savings and media quality, including VMAF for video. Originals are quarantined for rollback until approved or purged by the configured retention policy. Run CPU, Intel QSV/VA-API or NVIDIA NVENC jobs in the container, or pair Windows, macOS and Linux sidecars for distributed video encoding and verification. Integrates with Plex, Jellyfin, Emby, Sonarr and Radarr. The web UI shows libraries, queued work, quality reports and savings. Mount one read-write storage root at /data for media, work and quarantine. Review a small test set before enabling automatic replacement.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the Optimisarr web interface (container listens on 8787).

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Persistent application state: SQLite database and configuration. Keep on fast storage.

Config.Name: Storage root
Config.Description: One read-write root for your media, temporary output, and quarantine. Keeping them below one container mapping preserves atomic moves.

Config.Name: Work directory
Config.Description: Temporary transcode output inside the storage root. A separate fast-scratch mount requires the verified cross-filesystem fallback.

Config.Name: Quarantine directory
Config.Description: Rollback originals inside the storage root so replacements can use atomic moves.

Config.Name: Admin Token
Config.Description: Optional. When set, the administrative API and UI require this bearer token. Leave blank to rely on your network/reverse-proxy for access control.

Config.Name: Remote workers
Config.Description: Remote workers are available by default. Set false to disable the worker service for this deployment. Existing saved settings are preserved; pair trusted sidecars in Settings → Remote workers and choose work placement per library.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as (Unraid 'nobody' is 99). Files it creates use this owner.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as (Unraid 'users' is 100).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Permissions mask for files Optimisarr creates.

Config.Name: Intel/AMD GPU (/dev/dri)
Config.Description: Optional. Map the render node for Intel QSV/VA-API or AMD VA-API hardware transcoding. Remove if the host has no /dev/dri. For NVIDIA NVENC, add '--runtime=nvidia' and the NVIDIA_* variables via Extra Parameters instead (see the setup guide).
